claims: "TACO Trump" is a political acronym standing for "Trump Always Chickens Out."
Financial analyst Robert Armstrong coined "TACO Trump" in May 2025.
The term "TACO" was created to describe the "TACO trade" on Wall Street.
The "TACO trade" on Wall Street is where investors buy into the market during a dip, anticipating that Trump would reverse his aggressive tariff threats.
The term "TACO" resurfaced in March 2026 when President Trump postponed threatened strikes on Iran’s power plants after a 48-hour ultimatum.
Critics labeled President Trump’s postponement of threatened strikes on Iran’s power plants as a retreat.
Trump dismissed the term "TACO Trump," calling it a "nasty question."
Trump framed the reversals as a "negotiation" tactic rather than backing down.
The term relates to a 2025–2026 context.
There is a 2016 campaign phrase "taco trucks on every corner".
